run_suite_npu: run the multimodal_gen test suite with --suite 1-npu --partition-id 0 --total-partitions 1
partition_test_execution: partition test items across 4 parallel workers using --total-partitions 4 and --partition-id 0..3
filter_test_items: filter test items using --filter expression passed to pytest -k
continue_on_error: continue running remaining tests after a failure with --continue-on-error
collect_test_items: collect test node IDs from test files using pytest --collect-only before execution
